svg.title: A calendar of different legal events
svg.desc: A calendar of different legal events Selected EU milestones | supplementary observation: 25 October 2026 REGISTRY AND PASSPORT | fixed date or dated announcement 19 Jul 2026 EU registry: statutory deadline Deadline to establish the registry; not a service-completeness result. 20 Jul 2026 Registry availability announced Operational announcement; no live registration test in this paper. 18 Feb 2027 Covered battery passports: application LMT and EV batteries; industrial batteries above 2 kWh. ADJACENT PRODUCT REGIMES | these are not DPP mandates 20 Jan 2027 Machinery Regulation: main application Safety obligations; earlier provisions apply separately. 11 Dec 2027 Cyber Resilience Act: main application Manufacturer reporting began 11 September 2026. ESPR PRODUCT MEASURES | indicative adoption targets Q4 2026 Iron and steel Planned delegated act; no final act identified in targeted review. Q3-Q4 2027 Aluminium and tyres Planning window; final act determines application. Q4 2027 Textiles and apparel Sector-page target; broader timeline also gives Q3-Q4. 2028 / 2029 Furniture / mattresses Planned adoption years, not passport application dates. Adoption target is not an application date. ESPR product acts normally allow at least 18 months from entry into force to application, with exceptions. Do not add 18 months to a planning target.

rdf:Alt.rdf:li: A calendar of different legal events

Selected EU dates grouped into registry and passport events, adjacent product regimes and indicative ESPR adoption targets. Selected EU milestones observed on 25 October 2026. Fixed legal dates, availability announcements and indicative adoption targets are different event types. Machinery and CRA dates are adjacent obligations, not DPP mandates. Planned adoption is not an application deadline. Paper Figure 2, page 14.
